name: week
title: Practice week
subtitle: Fees, money and people that need a director this week

sections.title: Fee burning ahead of progress
sections.note: Share of the fee used in time against the percent complete. The gap is the warning.
sections.sql: select sp.number, sp.project, sp.stage, sp.percent_complete as complete, sp.fee_used_pct as fee_used, sp.total_fee as fee, sp.fee_left from stage_position sp cross join practice_profile p where sp.status = 'active' and sp.fee_type in ('fixed', 'percent', 'capped') and sp.total_fee > 0 and sp.fee_used_pct > sp.percent_complete + p.burn_tolerance order by sp.fee_used_pct - sp.percent_complete desc

sections.title: Work to invoice
sections.sql: select number, project, stage, fee_type, earned, invoiced, wip as to_invoice from stage_position where wip > 0 order by wip desc

sections.title: Overdue invoices
sections.sql: select name as invoice, client, due_on, balance, practice_today() - due_on as days_overdue from invoice_balances where status = 'issued' and balance > 0 and due_on < practice_today() order by due_on

sections.title: Variations waiting
sections.sql: select v.name as variation, p.name as project, v.description, v.fee, v.status, v.submitted_on from variations v join projects p on p.id = v.project_id where v.status in ('draft', 'submitted') order by v.submitted_on nulls last

sections.title: People, next four weeks
sections.sql: select name as person, week_of, available, planned, over_by from capacity where over_by > 0 or planned = 0 order by week_of, name

name: projects
title: Project fees
subtitle: Every project: fee, earned, invoiced and margin to date

sections.title: Projects
sections.sql: select number, name as project, client, manager, status, fee, earned, invoiced, wip as to_invoice, margin_to_date from project_position where fee > 0 order by number

sections.title: Stages
sections.sql: select number, stage, fee_type, total_fee as fee, percent_complete as complete, fee_used_pct as fee_used, invoiced, status from stage_position where fee_type <> 'none' order by number, sort
